purpose: W4.6 / BC-2 (PREREGISTRATION.md §4). Each entry justifies an AFFIRMATIVE use of the word 'validated'/'已验证' in a user-facing surface by naming the backing evidence artifact or the reason the use is legitimate. scripts/check_validated_claims.py fails CI on any affirmative 'validated' claim that matches NO entry here (negated/hedged uses — 'no validated edge', 'not a validated', 'unvalidated', '未验证' — are ignored automatically). Keep entries phrase-scoped, not file:line-scoped, so they survive page regeneration. Adding an entry is a claim of record: it must cite an artifact or a documented study.
notes: The `match` field is a case-insensitive substring that must appear on the same line as the token. `surfaces` is ENFORCED (2026-07-29): it lists the page/module surfaces the justification was written for, and a claim is backed only when the claiming file's surface is in the list — a phrase justified for one page never licenses another (scripts/check_validated_claims._surfaces_of maps file -> surface; the derivation is basename-minus-suffix, with site/<dir>/ item pages folded into their family and one-template-many-pages renders folded together). An entry with a missing or empty `surfaces` list backs NOTHING, so a new entry must always declare where it applies; when a claim moves to a new page, extend the entry only if the SAME backing covers that page, else write a new entry naming the study that does. `backing` names the artifact/doc that earns it. Order does not matter. DO NOT add entries for quoted third-party research: verbatim text mirrored from syndicated institutional notes (site/research/*.html, site/research/index.html, the baked catalog in site/research_vault.html) is skipped STRUCTURALLY by _THIRD_PARTY_PAGES in scripts/check_validated_claims.py, because reported speech from a named external author is not a platform claim and has no artifact to cite. An entry here is a claim of record; a third-party quote is not ours to make one about. If such a quote reds the gate, the sink is unmapped — extend _THIRD_PARTY_PAGES (and tests/test_validated_claims_thirdparty.py) rather than allowlisting the sentence.
